verdict.rationale: Brex documents per-transaction policy enforcement (rules applied to every transaction, an audit agent that flags violations by risk level) and approval routing. The API exposes recorded policy-check results on booking objects, showing which travel rules were violated, and AI approvals are described as having 'total transparency.' However, nothing documents a per-expense history log of edits and approvals, or audit-grade retention and export. missing for 10: documented per-expense edit/change history, an approval-history audit log, audit-ready export or immutable retention, independent or hands-on corroboration of audit survivability.
